transforms.name: vite:load-fallback
transforms.result:
{$t('recommendations.type.title')}

{#if error}
{error}
{:else if loaders.data}
{:else if recommendations.length === 0}

{$t('recommendations.type.not_found')}

{$t('recommendations.type.description')}

{:else}
{#each recommendations as item, index}

{item.task.title}

{#if item.task.isBoosted}
{$t('recommend.featured')}
{/if}

{item.task.description}

{item.task.taskType === 'remote' ? $t('recommend.remote') : $t('recommend.in_person')}
{item.task.budget?.amount || 'TBD'}{item.task.budget?.currency || ''}
{#if item.task.skills && item.task.skills.length > 0}
{#each item.task.skills.slice(0, 3) as skill} {skill} {/each} {#if item.task.skills.length > 3} +{item.task.skills.length - 3} {/if}
{/if}
{item.reason}
{#if index < recommendations.length - 1}
{/if} {/each}
{/if}
